chapter_title: CHAPTER 19. The Second Cloud
text: Jared Diamond explores the fasci- nating question of what in less than 2 percent of our genes has enabled us to found civilizations and religions, develop intricate languages, create art, learn science—and acquire the capacity to destroy all our achievements overnight.
